## Walkthrough

The `ForceLeaderFailover` test utility function is enhanced to add a post-failover synchronization checkpoint. After leader election completes and a new lease holder is verified, the function now waits for the kueue-controller-manager deployment to reach readiness and webhook endpoints to become available.

## Changes

**Leader Failover Test Synchronization**

|Layer / File(s)|Summary|
|---|---|
|**Post-failover controller readiness synchronization** <br> `test/util/e2e.go`|After leader election, `ForceLeaderFailover` now waits for the kueue-controller-manager deployment and webhook endpoints to be ready via `waitForKueueControllerReadyWithWebhookEndpoints`.|

🎯 2 (Simple) | ⏱️ ~5 minutes
